topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining its main learning outcomes and contextualising the material within histopathology.

topics.label: Tumor viruses, cellular oncogenes, and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the historical discovery of tumor viruses, the identification of cellular proto-oncogenes, and the experimental assays used to measure cellular transformation.

topics.label: Classification and mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classifications of cancer-associated mutations and illustrate their mechanistic actions using the G1/S checkpoint and p53.

topics.label: Forms, causes, and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how failures in specific DNA repair pathways and mitotic processes generate sequence instability and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Stepwise tumor evolution and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the multi-step progression of tumorigenesis and how inherited germline mutations accelerate cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture by reviewing the learning outcomes, suggesting supplementary reading, and previewing upcoming topics.
